title: Pizza
desc: Michael, a pizza delivery boy, lives with Anu, an aspiring horror fiction writer. One day, while delivering food, he goes to a bungalow where mysterious events begin to take place.

title: Devi
desc: Krishna reluctantly marries country girl Devi to please his family, but life turns upside down when a ghost possesses Devi.

title: Badhri
desc: When his kickboxer brother is attacked by enemies and ends up bedridden, Badri, a reckless boy, must fulfil his dream of winning the kickboxing championship.

title: Miruthan
desc: An intoxicated dog bites a security guard, unleashes a zombie outbreak. A traffic officer takes up the responsibility to find the antidote.

title: Thoranai
desc: A man manages to find his estranged brother, who had run away from home twenty years ago. However, his brother's miserable past life impedes him from starting afresh.
